name: skills-manager
description: An Electron React TypeScript SQLite based Skills Manager App.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:main && concurrently -k "pnpm run dev:renderer" "cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 node node_modules/electron/cli.js ."
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.main.json tsconfig.renderer.json vite.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml src
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.main.json tsconfig.renderer.json vite.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml src
